questions.stemHtml: A 23-years-old male had unprotected sexual intercourse with a commercial sex worker. Two weeks later, he developed a painless, indurated ulcer on the glans which exuded clear serum on pressure as shown. Inguinal lymph nodes in both groins were enlarged and not tender. The most appropriate diagnostic test is:

options.label: B
options.text: Dark field microscopy of ulcer discharge
